Class Promotion

java.lang.Object
dev.swordai.core.curriculum.Promotion
public final class Promotion extends Object
When a stage counts as learned. Every threshold that is set must hold over the recent window; a value of zero (or below) means "not checked".

    • styleOptionalAfterSteps

      public int styleOptionalAfterSteps
      A habit that is slow to form must not hold up everything after it. Once this many steps have been played in the stage, the thresholds that are about how it fights rather than whether it can (minMixStrafe, minMixTiming, minPunishRate, minCritShare, minJumpCritRate, minBackRate, minOutRate) no longer have to be met for the stage to be passed; all the others still do. Whatever those were teaching stays on and paid for in every later stage. Zero: they always have to be met.
